focus.turn_just_completed.contents: Body square to point of focus. Dress swaying from recent rotation. Feet positioned. Eyes locked on focus.

focus.head_oriented_close.contents: Face lifting to meet overhead focus. Eyes and face aligning upward toward focus position. Natural upward gaze with face following. Responding to focus above.

focus.turn_three_quarter.contents: Body 45deg from frontal. Shoulders rotating toward point of focus. Dress swirling. Head turned more than body. Eyes finding focus.

focus.turn_overshot_correcting.contents: Body rotated beyond focus position. Dress directional confusion. Balance slightly off. Eyes locked but body imperfect.

focus.turn_halfway_stalled.contents: Body 60deg from frontal. Partial rotation then stopped. Dress arrested movement. Weight distribution awkward.

focus.head_leads_body_lags.contents: Face oriented to point of focus, neck twisted, shoulders still rotating. Dress body rotation. Strain visible in neck position.

focus.body_leads_head_follows.contents: Body square to focus, shoulders and torso frontal. Head still turning in. Neck in active rotation. Eyes searching. Dress settled frontal.
